# benchmark-ranking-stability

> Reproducible model-ranking sensitivity across tasks, repeated runs, and prompt variants.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-ranking-stability
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-ranking-stability
Directory: https://aibenchmarkindex.com/benchmarks/benchmark-ranking-stability

## Modes

Mode A: `score-stability` reads two or more benchmark-family RunReport files. It writes Kendall tau-b, first-place probabilities, 95% rank intervals, and an SVG.

Mode B: 60 seeded synthetic reasoning items each have five prompt variants. The exact grader trims whitespace and normalizes Unicode.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, `score`, `kendallTauB`, `renderVolatilityChart`, and `scoreStabilityFiles`. The `/api` export provides a fetch-style handler. The `/mcp` export provides MCP builders.

## Commands

Commands: list, show, run, score, score-stability, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, mcp.

The mock provider works offline. OpenRouter uses `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`. An OpenAI-compatible endpoint uses `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

## Data and verification

Public data seed: 20261015. Generate a hidden split with `node scripts/gen-tasks.mjs --seed N --split hidden`. Run `npm run ci:local`; its report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
